rci1_using_msad.detail: Single site (Oslo University Hospital); three separate normative models each built on a single scanner (Discovery: 1.5T Siemens MAGNETOM Sonata; Replication 1: 3T GE 750 Discovery; Replication 2: 3T GE Signa HDxT). Each model's reference cohort is from one scanner at one site.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Discovery: Structural scans were obtained on 1.5 Tesla Siemens MAGNETOM Sonata scanner at Oslo University Hospital" "Replication 1: Structural scans were obtained on 3 Tesla GE 750 Discovery scanner at Oslo University Hospital" "Replication 2: Structural scans were obtained on 3 Tesla GE Signa HDxT at Oslo University Hospital"

rci2_using_epd.detail: All participants recruited from the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study; TOP is in the EPD list
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study, approved by the Regional Committee for Medical Research Ethics and the Norwegian Data Inspectorate (Doan et al., 2017)."

rci3_epd_name.detail: TOP (Thematically Organized Psychosis) study; all three samples (Discovery, Replication 1, Replication 2) drawn from the same TOP study population
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "All participants were recruited as part of the Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study" "The two replication samples were selected from the TOP-database on the 25th of September 2019."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC for each model; each model trained on the full healthy sample of that scanner under 10-fold cross-validation for evaluation, then one model fitted on all healthy individuals applied to patients
